# laravelforge_org_team_member (Data Source)

Fetches a single member of a Laravel Forge team by user ID.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (Number) Numeric ID of the user whose membership is fetched.
- `organization` (String) Organization slug.
- `team_id` (Number) ID of the team the membership belongs to.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Membership creation timestamp.
- `email` (String) Member's email address.
- `name` (String) Member's name.
- `updated_at` (String) Membership update timestamp.
